🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 22, 2026

Moon, exalted in Taurus, holds a square to Pluto, in Aquarius. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you own is being counted by somebody else’s arithmetic.

Easier — Saying no to a thing you can afford and do not want.
Harder — Treating a passing squeeze as a permanent condition.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you from Leo, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. From Sagittarius, Sun concedes the point early. Fire that starts things, started cheaply. It has held two weeks without changing its terms.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fixed earth: what is kept and who keeps it merge. After four weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you from Scorpio on plain terms, without privilege. From Sagittarius, Sun quotes your worth back at you. Mutable air keeps two accounts open and pays both. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, honoured in Taurus. From Libra, Venus cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Water moves first and pays first. The hold Mercury had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Sagittarius. Moon squares you from Taurus, and something has to give way. Fire keeps its grip past the point it is worth. The Scorpio chapter closed four weeks ago.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon trines you from Taurus, meeting no resistance. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. Forward again for two weeks now, Mercury has left the old ground.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. From Sagittarius, Sun offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Cardinal air opens the account without argument. The conjunction of four weeks ago is off it now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon faces you from Taurus, holding the other figures. Fixed water: the grip costs more than the thing. The square to Mercury that held three weeks ago has let go.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Sun is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Mutable fire: both answers turn out to be one answer. Unchanged for four weeks: you know what it asks.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon in Taurus sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal earth: the opening move is the cheap one. Four weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. From Taurus, Moon cuts across the appetite. Fixed air: the grip is the expense. Three weeks ago Saturn was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Taurus, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Mutable water keeps two accounts, and both balance. What pressed four weeks ago has cleared.
